papers.title: Reconstruction and well-posedness of an inverse coefficient problem for a diffusion equation
authors: Siyu Cen, Bangti Jin, Yavar Kian, Zhi Zhou
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2611.06112v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this work, we investigate the inverse coefficient problem of determining an unknown coefficient in a diffusion equation from a single boundary flux measurement. More precisely, assuming that the domain is cylindrical, we develop a unified theoretical and numerical framework for the stable reconstruction of a space-time-dependent coefficient, by reformulating the inverse problem as a nonlinear equation. The inherent nonlinearity of the problem is transferred to an auxiliary nonlinear equation, enabling the application of techniques and concepts from nonlinear analysis.
